literal: Sweet words free from meanness will give happiness both in the next life and in this life.
translation: Sweet speech, free from all meanness, yields happiness both in this life and in the life to come.
modern: பிறருக்குத் துன்பம் தராத இனிய சொற்கள், ஒருவருக்கு இப்பிறப்பிலும் மறுபிறப்பிலும் இன்பத்தைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the dual benefit of speaking sweet words that are devoid of meanness or the intent to cause harm. Such pleasant speech does not just bring joy and harmonious relationships in the present life, but also accumulates spiritual merit that brings happiness in the next life. The key term 'சிறுமையுவு நீங்கிய' (traditionally 'சிறுமையுள் நீங்கிய') emphasizes that true sweet words must be completely free from pettiness, malice, or deceit. Thus, gentle and kind words are a source of eternal happiness.
